document.about: Hoshizaki KM-515MAJ ice machine spec sheet (2 pages), as a dealer hosts it. Some of its dimensions set the whole fraction small and raised after the whole number, with no space between them.

notes: 2026-11-23: a mixed number set this way read as one number, 2113/16 for 21 13/16 (#46).
